rows.evidence: Q1: Sections II-B, II-G, III-B and III-C; the authors measured leaf and canopy hyperspectral reflectance of winter wheat inoculated with powdery mildew, yellow rust and aphids at the Xiaotangshan experimental base, derived four new spectral indices (HI, PMI, YRI, AI) with the RELIEF-F algorithm, and report classification accuracies (Table I, 86.5-93.5% at leaf scale; 82.4-87.6% at canopy scale) and a YRI-DI regression (Fig. 7, R2 0.86 on verification).
rows.notes: The study only shows that the new indices detect and discriminate powdery mildew, yellow rust and aphid infection (and estimate severity via DI) from leaf-scale and non-imaging canopy-scale spectra at a single experimental site. It does not report any farmer action, management intervention or prevention of further damage, nor any spatial mapping of affected areas (the authors state imaging data were unavailable and detection was at middle disease stage, not early). Detection is a precondition of the claimed pest-control effect, so Q2 is 'no' and upstream is set. No triangulation (spectroscopy only, DI visual scoring is the reference not an independent method on the control effect), single site, no scale above plot.

notes: Full text available; some numeric values (coordinates, R2 of PMI-DI, equations) are missing from the OCR but this does not affect the rating.
